svg.title: Does the code still satisfy what the agent claimed it did?
svg.desc: dorian: claim warrants for code changes. Does the code still satisfy what the agent claimed it did? Claims become executable checks sealed beside the code and re-run on every commit. No model is called at check time. Evidence card, from the README Try it recipe: claim handler-exists, 'handler() lives in app.py'. dorian verify: verified 1/1 claim(s), WARRANTED (exit 0). A refactor renames handler(); the note never changes. dorian revalidate: handler-exists BROKEN, REVOKED (exit 4). A black-box test pins this recipe.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
